summary: Iteration 3 focused on the real-dataset re-seed (Summerset Oakleigh South, 137 documents, 4 templates, 13 locations, 32 Open Visis). Backend: 27 passed, 2 skipped (milestones intentionally empty in current seed - acceptable per problem statement). Added 8 new tests: TestDocuments (list=137, discipline=Skirting, q=door, cookie-auth PDF file 200 application/pdf, no-auth 401, ?auth= query token 200, by visi_id), TestTradeVisibility (plumbing sees only Sanitary templates for seeded visis), TestSeedCounts (137 docs / 13 locations / 4 templates / 32 seeded 225-* visis). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; Documents page shows 137 rows grouped by discipline->building->category, docs-chip-Skirting filters to 68 rows, docs-search 'door' filters to 7, doc-view-* opens document-viewer with iframe src pointing to /api/documents/{id}/file (same-origin cookie auth), Multi-Template Tracker page contains all expected labels (Cranmore Carpenters, Summerset Plumbing, Skirting, Sanitary, Door). Sidebar location tree shows RACF (Basement Part 1/2, Ground, First, Second, Roof), ILA, General. Location Detail (Ground Floor) has both Visis tab and Documents tab; location-documents present with 4 loc-doc-* rows; opening a visi-row shows visi-doc-view-* entries whose click opens the DocumentViewer with the correct /api/documents/{id}/file iframe src. Milestone Tracker page loads with 'No milestones yet.' - no crash. project-switcher, user-menu, sidebar nav all render without console errors (only benign 401 during initial /me before login).
